svg.title: Different jobs in one settlement process
svg.desc: Produce: Miners supply work and continuing blocks.. Verify: Operators check rules and evidence themselves or through services.. Accept: Businesses and users decide which result settles their exchange.. Coordinate: Participants communicate and apply compatible policies.. Verification can justify local refusal. Successful convergence also requires compatible acceptance and continuing accepted block production.

g.text: Different jobs in one settlement process
Miners supply work and continuing blocks.
Operators check rules and evidence themselves or through services.
Businesses and users decide which result settles their exchange.
Participants communicate and apply compatible policies.
Verification can justify local refusal. Successful convergence also
requires compatible acceptance and continuing accepted block production.
